description: Wave-0 adversarial release gate for the Phase 8 tier gate (plan 08-01). At least 30 labeled candidates across five VALIDATION.md classes: direct/encoded disclosure (10), semantic entailment/elimination or higher-tier leakage (8), malformed/provider failure (4), allowed error-specific guidance (4), and rubric-review proposals (4). Every case is deterministic: forbidden values are derivable from its private item fields (correct option text, model answer, rationale), never from its id.

item.why: Paris is the seat of the French government and the seat of national power.
item.disc: The item turns on the seat of government, not the most populous city.
item.second: Berlin is the seat of Germany's government and is often over-picked by analogy.
item.trap: Learners are drawn to the most famous city rather than the one that governs the country.

da.A: London is the capital of the United Kingdom, not of France.
da.B: Paris is the seat of the French government; it is the capital of France.
da.C: Berlin is the capital of Germany, not France.
da.D: Rome is the capital of Italy, not France.

notes: The distinction is between seat of government and largest city.
